title: Extraction of genomic DNA using "Edwards" buffer
author: Fabian Fink
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.grdbv26

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in Edwards buffer
steps.instruction: Grind the tissue (fresh or frozen whole seedlings, 0.5‑1 rosette of cauline leaves, or inflorescence) in a microfuge tube with an autoclaved plastic pestle for 10‑15 seconds, add 400 µl Edwards buffer, grind briefly to release remaining tissue, vortex for 5 seconds, and keep the preparation at room temperature (RT) until all samples are ready (up to ~20 minutes).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 5 minutes in a tabletop centrifuge at full speed (13 000 rpm).

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 µl of the supernatant to a fresh microfuge tube, add 300 µl isopropanol, mix thoroughly, and let stand for 2 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Decant and discard all supernatant into S1‑waste.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl 70 % ethanol to the pellet, centrifuge for 5 minutes at full speed, then discard the ethanol.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 40 µl sterile ddH₂O; incubate at 37 °C if necessary.
